descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S18 Hospital day window on sparse and messy ledgers: only yesterday's and today's lines, no filler, nothing older

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)
  • U2 A day the patient was not seen is legitimately absent: no entry and no filler line for it. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 description 2)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Four seeded Hospital patients (server-clock labels). HA: '{day-3}' + '{day0}' (yesterday not seen). HB: only '{day-2}'. HC: only '{day-1}'. HD: an undated legacy line, '{day-5}', '{day-1}', '{day0}', and a '{day-3}' line typed by hand beneath today's

When Open each chart's Pre-Round tab (view only, editor closed)

Then HA: only today's card; no '{day-3}' card and no filler card for yesterday. HB: no cards. HC: just yesterday's card, nothing for today. HD: yesterday's card, then today's; the 5-days-ago and 3-days-ago lines are not on the cards; the undated line is Q6

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per patient, scoped to the Course Timeline. This is what tells the 'yesterday and today' window (U3) from a 'two most recent dated lines' build, the bug class of the 2026-10-02 rejection ('last 3 lines'): such a build shows '{day-3}' for HA and '{day-2}' for HB. HA/HC also prove a day not seen stays absent with no filler (U2, Hospital). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
